description: This file contains validation functions for StorageVersion objects in Kubernetes, including name validation, status validation, and version format validation.

methods.name: ValidateStorageVersion
methods.description: Validates the StorageVersion object, including metadata and status.

methods.name: ValidateStorageVersionName
methods.description: Validates the name of a StorageVersion, ensuring it follows the <group>.<resource> format.

methods.name: ValidateStorageVersionUpdate
methods.description: Validates an update to a StorageVersion object; currently always returns no errors.

methods.name: ValidateStorageVersionStatusUpdate
methods.description: Validates an update to a StorageVersionStatus object.

methods.name: validateStorageVersionStatus
methods.description: Validates the status of a StorageVersion, including server IDs, versions, and conditions.

methods.name: validateServerStorageVersion
methods.description: Validates individual server storage version details, including API server ID and versions.

methods.name: commonVersion
methods.description: Determines the common encoding version among server storage versions.

methods.name: validateCommonVersion
methods.description: Validates the common encoding version consistency.

methods.name: validateStorageVersionCondition
methods.description: Validates conditions associated with StorageVersion status.

methods.name: isValidAPIVersion
methods.description: Checks if an API version string is valid according to DNS label rules.

methods.name: prefixEach
methods.description: Prefixes each message in a list with a given string.
